description: We’re Just_Engineers, a team of engineering and computer science students who are interested in space, technology, and building things together. We chose the Martian Map challenge because we liked the idea of thinking about what it would actually be like to explore and survive on Mars. We’re looking for people who enjoy coding, design, research, mapping, or just solving problems and trying new ideas.
summary:
Once Upon A Space is an interactive web experience designed to make space exploration more exciting and accessible. Instead of simply reading about NASA missions, users get to explore them through interactive stories, mini-games, challenges, and real mission information.

Each mission offers a different experience inspired by the challenges faced by real NASA spacecraft and rovers. Players can explore, make decisions, solve problems, and learn how space missions work along the way. We also included AI-powered assistants to make the experience more interactive and allow users to ask questions about the missions.

Our goal was to turn learning about space into something people can enjoy, not just something they read in a textbook. We wanted to combine science, creativity, and gameplay in one experience that encourages curiosity about space exploration.
details: Once Upon A Space is an interactive space exploration experience that brings real NASA missions closer to users through gameplay, storytelling, and technology. The project allows users to explore space missions in a more engaging way instead of simply reading scientific information. Each mission offers its own experience, with different challenges, gameplay mechanics, and objectives inspired by real space exploration events. Players can make decisions, solve problems, discover scientific facts, and learn about the challenges faced by NASA's robotic explorers. One of the main features is the AI-powered mission assistant, which allows users to ask questions and learn more about the mission they are exploring. We aim to make space science easier to understand and more enjoyable, especially for younger audiences. The project was developed as a web-based experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with AI integration through Google's Gemini technology. What makes our idea creative is the combination of real scientific information with interactive gameplay. We wanted to create an experience where learning happens naturally through exploration, curiosity, and problem-solving. Our main goal is to inspire more people to become interested in space science and understand the importance of robotic missions in exploring our universe.
